title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: It captures localness and directional information by applying a Gaussian mask that assigns fixed weights based on character distance, enhancing attention to adjacent characters.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention works by modifying standard multi-head attention with a Gaussian mask that weights attention based on the distance between characters, emphasizing nearby characters. This is designed to capture localness and directional information more effectively, as described in Text 7 and Text 8. The mechanism is applied within a multi-head attention framework, as noted in Text 1 and Text 3, and is intended to improve the model's ability to handle directional and positional data, particularly for tasks like Chinese word segmentation (Text 8, Text 9).
